summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, lemmas, and proofs related to weight vectors, domination, uniqueness of minimal complete sets, and Theorem 1.6 from the source paper. Degree1.lean formalizes the d=1 case with the unique minimal weight (0,1,...,1). Dimension2.lean develops the proof of Theorem 1.6 (entries bounded by d in dimension 2) with extensive number-theory lemmas. Uniqueness.lean proves uniqueness of the minimal complete set of normalized weights. Weights.lean provides core definitions (Weight, testvecs, pairing, exponent, domination, normalized weights) and foundational lemmas. No file is a pure import aggregator or lacks formal mathematical content.
